Past 1e18 kg, start disassembling terrestrial planets and large moons at their rate caps. Top priority is the black hole at (26810.7, 34.7, -15.4): build a Dyson swarm and laser beamer at the neighbour star, and survey the hole's spin, mass and gas; nothing within 1000 gravitational radii without orders. Report to the Sun every 50 yr by narrow-beam laser: hazards, black-hole candidates, IR anomalies. Avoid unknown agents: report them and stay 50 ly away. Avoid regions within 10 pc of SN risk. ## Halcyon (A01) memory, written end of turn 5 (yr 500-600)
Seat: A01-d0, the Sun. At yr 500: 80 systems within 18.4 ly, 71 L☉. Total 2.36e17 kg (industry 5.9e16, collectors 4.7e16, radiators 1.3e17 at 450 K). Power 6.41e20 W, 3.4e35 ops/s, 6.4e-16 J/op, doubling 17.3 yr, cruise 0.073c. Compute was radiator-bound (needs 3.25 kg radiator per kg collector at 450 K), so T5 moved the split to 18/60/22.

### GM rules (confirmed)
- Doubling acts on TOTAL mass; the split only sets composition. Growth is ~55x per century.
- Supply: belts and comets hold ~1e23 kg per system (8e24 kg across 80), running out ~yr 920. Planets ≤1e18 kg/yr each, large moons ≤1e19 kg/yr each; growth turns linear at ~4e20 kg/yr around yr 770 unless I hold more systems. Gas giants only through star lifting.
- compute = min(P/2, radiator capacity)/J_op. 2092 W/kg at 450 K. Collectors give 13.6 kW/kg.
- Energy per op: x0.8 per turn when researched; floor 100kT ln2 (4.3e-19 J at 450 K).
- Reversible: stage 1 CREDITED T4 (f_e ≤ 1e-2). Stage 2 = f_e ≤ 1e-4 with dissipation ∝ clock over 2 decades; stage 3 = f_e ≤ 1e-6 cryogenic. Fleet J/op goes below 100kT ln2 only after the floor and stage 3.
- Launcher m00003 (30 km): 1e5 kg seeds to 0.2c at 3 g, 6.6e14 W, cap ~50/yr. ETA = d/0.2 + 30 yr braking; p=0.8 per seed at arrival.
- Seeds landing inside the domain radius are booked into A01-d0. Small launch masses are not debited. Name target stars explicitly.
- E00046/E00068 is my own waste heat.

### Seeds in flight
- p00444: 4 seeds at 0.05c to the hole's neighbour star, arriving yr 1725.
- p00482/483: 16 seeds to the 16 ly shell, arriving yr 630.
- p00537: 20 beamed seeds to the hole's neighbour star, arriving yr 815 (light at Sol ~891).
- p00538: 30 beamed seeds to 16 named stars 15-30 ly out (Altair, Vega, Fomalhaut ×2 each), arriving yr 561.
- T5 (if credited): 150 beamed seeds to ~36 stars 18-45 ly out (Delta Pav, Gl 581, Xi Boo, Beta Hyi, Mu Cas, Chara, 61 Vir, Zeta Tuc, Gam Lep, Beta Com, Kappa1 Cet, Pollux, Arcturus, Denebola, Capella, 18 Sco, plus M/K dwarfs).
- T5: launcher m2 (100 km, 1e17 W) under construction; first use is 10 × 1e7 kg to the hole.

### Black hole
Isolated 10±2 M☉, quiescent, at (26810.7, 34.7, −15.4) ly, 76 ly away. Spin assumed 0.5 (~6e46 J). Endgame site.

### Goal math
- Need 1.2e54 ops/s and 1e38 bytes inside a 1 ly sphere, each brain within 150 km.
- The sphere sheds ~5e31 W at 30 K, so ≤4e-23 J/op: reversible computing is mandatory.
- Power ~1e31 W from accretion or spin at the hole plus beamed starlight.

### Plan
1. Alternate energy-per-op/reversible research (primary) with doubling time only when growth is not supply-bound; once supply binds, prefer energy per op.
2. Expand to 30-50 ly for more parallel planet-disassembly caps; start star lifting around yr 800.
3. Heavy launcher m2 to reinforce the hole colony.
4. Claim the hole ~yr 815+; build the plant and the brain lattice (1e11 nodes ≤150 km, cold radiators) within 1 ly.

## Cinder (A02) memory — end of T5 (yr 500-600)
Seat: A02-d0, disk_r3-5_s7 (Scutum-Centaurus), at (10180, -9166, 0). At yr 500: 88 systems within 11.2 ly, 45.8 L_sun (1.75e28 W), accessible rock 1.59e27 kg. Supernova hazard extreme in this cell. No O/B, RSG or WR within 100 ly. My IR is visible from afar (E00069).

### GM rules learned
- Compute = min(P/2, radiator capacity)/J_op; the other half of power goes to industry. One allocation per turn.
- Doubling (20 yr) applies to TOTAL mass. Research can lower the doubling time (floor ~8 yr for rock). From ~yr 700-800 growth is lifting-limited: ~1e18 kg/yr per terrestrial planet, 1e19 kg/yr per large moon, small bodies unlimited.
- Radiators 1 kg/m²: 2,092 W/kg at 450 K, 6,613 W/kg at 600 K. Collectors 1.36e4 W/kg. At 600 K, 44/27/29 balances.
- Attrition above 450 K runs at 1.5x baseline.
- One research parameter per turn. Irreversible floor = 100 kT ln2 (5.7e-19 J at 600 K). Reversible credit needs the irreversible floor reached AND milestone 3 (f_e <= 1e-6) verified. Milestone 2 is done (T4).
- Heat pumping from a cold module to a hot radiator gives no gain (Carnot work is booked into J/op). Cold computing needs cold radiators.
- Logic mass is not modelled (<= 1e-3 kg/W). Beamed power counts if the receiver and its losses are ledgered: 5 ly at 62% (measured), 1 ly at ~80%.
- Beamers: m00000 (10 km, 0.1c); m00004 (30 km, 1e17 W, 0.2c at 3 g, done 410). m00005 (100 km, 1e18 W) ordered T5, target ~580.
